newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI buys new crane for Manila port.
newsitem.headline: ATI buys new crane for Manila port.

text.p: The Asian Terminals Inc (ATI) said on Monday it had bought a new ship-to-shore crane from Mitsui Engineering & Shipbuilding Co Ltd for its Manila port.
The crane, which will be fully operational on December 10, will boost the container handling capability of the port, the company said in a statement.
ATI did not disclose the cost of the new crane.

With the delivery of the new crane, the port will have a total of six ship-to-shore container cranes. The company is buying three additional cranes for delivery in the first half of next year, it added.
The new crane is capable of handling 20-, 40-, and 45-foot containers.

"The cranes ... will allow the company to service the ever-expanding needs of container clients as well as move towards realising the vision of transforming the South Harbour into a world-class port," ATI's container terminal manager Paul Finley said. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
